messages:
mina: flagging a small but noisy gap: some tenants see v2 in console but router still routes to v1 for ~30-90s. Seen in customer QA and a few internal e2e runs.

oscar: can you paste an example trace/id?

mina: trace=trc-20240505-xx72; request at 09:12:07 shows route=v1 but console says migrated at 09:11:45.

kai: likely the same cache-epoch problem we've been tiptoeing around. console flip writes migration_epoch=42; router cached epoch was 41 for a handful of tenants and only refreshes on TTL or explicit invalidation.

rahul: short repro: toggle migration in console -> immediately send request from a headerless client -> watch /debug/route or logs. reproducible locally.

mina: impact: small percent of requests hit old model semantics; causes schema mismatches for some customers. We should avoid customer-facing inconsistency.

oscar: mitigation options: 
- hotfix 1: console write triggers synchronous cache invalidation call to router (blocking call, wait for ack)
- hotfix 2: console shows transitional state "evicting" instead of final migrated until router ack returns
- medium: introduce per-tenant route_epoch in router cache and increment on every migration so routing compares epoch numbers instead of relying on TTL
- long: switch router to config-stream push model instead of pull/queue

kai: technical note: sync invalidation easiest but we must be careful about cascading latency on console toggles if router ACKs are slow. wrap in 2s timeout and surface failure to UI.

rahul: telemetry to add:
- metric: route_epoch_mismatch.count (labels: tenant, from_epoch, to_epoch)
- metric: requests_routed_diff_from_console.count (labels: tenant, request_sample)
- sampled traces for mismatches with sampling 0.1

support-bot: created ticket SVC-3112 and added link to internal ops: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/ALRT-1199

mina: UI suggestion: add ephemeral badge on tenant page: "migration: eviction_in_progress" (yellow) and only flip to green when router confirms. this avoids customers thinking migration is immediately complete.

oscar: agree. we should also add a short recommended client header: `X-Route: prefer=v2` for customers who can set it, to accelerate pin on server side. add to docs and migration guide.

kai: I'll prototype the epoch compare change: router cache entry will store {epoch, timestamp} and routing decision will treat request_epoch (from console) > cached_epoch as higher priority and trigger immediate eviction+re-eval. Need to change the router atomic compare-and-invalidate logic.

rahul: owner assignments?
- oscar: console sync invalidation + UI state (hotfix)
- kai: router epoch compare PR (medium)
- mina: docs + support note and sample header text
- rahul: telemetry, dashboard panel, and ops alert threshold (0.05% mismatch over 5m)

deploy-bot: planned canary window tomorrow 03:00 UTC for console hotfix; will do 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green.

oscar: I'll open PR and include a fallback: if router doesn't ack within 2s, mark UI state as eviction_failed and surface retry button. also add audit log entry for toggles with epoch values.

mina: consider billing/comp policy if mismatch leads to extra token usage; notify finance if we see >$2000 across tenants.

kai: one more debug helper: add response header `X-Routing-Observed-Epoch: 41` when route != console_epoch so support can triage without logs. behind feature flag debug.routing_epoch_header.

oscar: good call. default off. we'll enable for staging for 48h.

mina: timeline: PRs today, staging smoke tonight, canary tomorrow. Post updates in #release-war-room. thanks all.
